motivation.text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
motivation.author: Mark Twain

motivation.text: It always seems impossible until it's done.
motivation.author: Nelson Mandela

motivation.text: Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right.
motivation.author: Henry Ford

motivation.text: Well done is better than well said.
motivation.author: Benjamin Franklin

motivation.text: Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
motivation.author: Aristotle

motivation.text: The best way out is always through.
motivation.author: Robert Frost

wisdom.text: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
wisdom.author: Socrates

wisdom.text: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
wisdom.author: Aristotle

wisdom.text: He who knows others is wise; he who knows himself is enlightened.
wisdom.author: Lao Tzu

wisdom.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
wisdom.author: Seneca

wisdom.text: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
wisdom.author: Aristotle

stoic.text: You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
stoic.author: Marcus Aurelius

stoic.text: We cannot choose our external circumstances, but we can always choose how we respond to them.
stoic.author: Epictetus

stoic.text: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
stoic.author: Seneca

stoic.text: It is not the man who has too little, but the man who craves more, that is poor.
stoic.author: Seneca

stoic.text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
stoic.author: Marcus Aurelius

stoic.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
stoic.author: Epictetus

tech.text: Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
tech.author: Harold Abelson

tech.text: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.
tech.author: Arthur C. Clarke

tech.text: Premature optimization is the root of all evil.
tech.author: Donald Knuth

tech.text: First, solve the problem. Then, write the code.
tech.author: John Johnson

tech.text: The computer was born to solve problems that did not exist before.
tech.author: Bill Gates
